label: Question 1
value: What comes in a school supply kit?

label: Answer 1
value: Each kit contains one spiral notebook, one folder, twelve colored pencils, five pencils, and five pens.

label: Question 2
value: Who can request supplies?

label: Answer 2
value: We work with schools, youth organizations, and community partners serving students across Chicagoland. Use our supply request form to tell us what your students need.

label: Question 3
value: Can I donate used school supplies?

label: Answer 3
value: Yes. We collect new and gently used supplies and refurbish usable materials. Please contact our team before dropping off a donation.

label: Question 4
value: Can students start a chapter?

label: Answer 4
value: Yes. You will need a Chapter President, Treasurer, and Public Relations Officer. Our Chapter Management Team helps new chapters get started.

label: Question 5
value: What does a $5 gift provide?

label: Answer 5
value: A $5 gift can provide one complete school supply kit. Donations also support the starter supplies our chapters need to collect, refurbish, and distribute materials.

label: Question 1
value: Can I start a chapter as a high school student?

label: Answer 1
value: Yes. The chapter program is built for high school students. You will need a Chapter President, Treasurer, and Public Relations Officer.

label: Question 2
value: Do we need new supplies?

label: Answer 2
value: We collect new and gently used materials. Refurbishing usable supplies is part of the chapter’s work.

label: Question 3
value: Where do the supplies go?

label: Answer 3
value: We work with elementary schools and other youth organizations. Chapters are matched with local needs so students can contribute in their own communities.

label: Question 4
value: Who can help us get started?

label: Answer 4
value: Contact our Chapter Management Team at suhanakoshal@gmail.com
